title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 40,757 Official Dossiers Across 38 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, Frictionless Data Package, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 40,757 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 897 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 38 active jurisdictions: United States (15,401 dossiers | Catalog), United Kingdom (2,905 dossiers | Catalog), Canada (5,380 dossiers | Catalog), European Union (4,972 dossiers | Catalog), United Nations (6,978 dossiers | Catalog), Ireland (184 dossiers | Catalog), Australia (1,289 dossiers | Catalog), International (1,107 dossiers | Catalog), Austria (171 dossiers | Catalog), Switzerland (190 dossiers | Catalog), Finland (67 dossiers | Catalog), France (443 dossiers | Catalog), South Korea (66 dossiers | Catalog), Norway (71 dossiers | Catalog), Italy (76 dossiers | Catalog), Philippines (396 dossiers | Catalog), Poland (43 dossiers | Catalog), South Africa (46 dossiers | Catalog), India (15 dossiers | Catalog), Belgium (57 dossiers | Catalog), Brazil (85 dossiers | Catalog), Japan (93 dossiers | Catalog), Netherlands (35 dossiers | Catalog), Russia (34 dossiers | Catalog), Sweden (49 dossiers | Catalog), China (31 dossiers | Catalog), Czechia (36 dossiers | Catalog), Germany (150 dossiers | Catalog), Denmark (41 dossiers | Catalog), Estonia (16 dossiers | Catalog), Spain (41 dossiers | Catalog), Israel (139 dossiers | Catalog), Iceland (14 dossiers | Catalog), Lithuania (0 dossiers | Catalog), Portugal (34 dossiers | Catalog), Saudi Arabia (19 dossiers | Catalog), Singapore (82 dossiers | Catalog), Ukraine (1 dossiers | Catalog).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt), and Wikidata entity Q142071440.
